Class DecodeCudaGraphLog

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.DecodeCudaGraphLog
public final class DecodeCudaGraphLog extends Object
INFO logging for decode CUDA graph bucket lifecycle (once per bucket event).

Used to compare on-demand capture hitches vs pre-captured bucket promotion.
